title: MetaVoiceChat
summary: Self-contained proximity voice chat for Unity, designed to work with the networking stack a game already uses.
description: MetaVoiceChat packages capture, Opus encoding, jitter-aware playback, optional noise suppression, and networking adapters into a modular Unity system.
challenge: Give multiplayer Unity projects production-minded voice chat without forcing a separate hosted voice service or a single networking vendor.
decisions: Use pooled buffers to avoid routine runtime allocations
Expose input, output, and filter extension points
Ship concrete adapters for common Unity networking libraries
outcomes: Games using MetaVoiceChat have reached more than six million players
Supports Mirror, Netcode for GameObjects, FishNet, and Netick
Open source under the MIT License
